title: Refreshing a stale Telegram preview
description: Changed your image or title but Telegram still shows the old card? Here's how to force it to fetch the page again.

blocks.text: Telegram caches previews per URL. After you fix a title or image, chats will keep showing the old version until the cache is refreshed.

items: Send it the exact URL you want refreshed (up to 10 per message).
The bot replies with the new preview. New shares will use it.

blocks.title: Quick workaround
blocks.text: While testing, add a throwaway query string like `?v=2`. Telegram treats it as a new URL and fetches it fresh.
Check that your host isn't serving a cached HTML file, and that the image URL itself changed or was re-uploaded. Telegram caches images separately from pages.
